facts.material: electronic PPG sensor with LEDs, textile bands, tablet with app, cables and adapters
facts.function: continuous non-invasive measurement of pulse rate and SpO2, data sent by Bluetooth to app and cloud
facts.form: retail set/kit: sensor, four textile bands, tablet with monitor app, charging cables, power adapters, instructions
facts.end_use: monitoring children's cardiovascular parameters by parents and clinicians

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9018 covers electro-diagnostic apparatus for checking physiological parameters (pulse oximeters held to be 9018 in H338599)
GRI 3(b): kit put up together; essential character is given by the PPG sensor that measures PR and SpO2, the tablet and bands being accessories/display

rejected_alternatives.reason: patient monitoring systems; a single-sensor pulse/SpO2 device with spot app is closer to the pulse oximeter rulings than a multi-parameter monitoring system (arguable)
smartwatch/fitness tracker ruling N349122 concerns consumer devices; this device is a medical SpO2 monitor
the tablet is only the display/recording unit of the kit and does not give essential character
parts and accessories; the sensor is the principal apparatus

missing_facts: whether CBP would treat the sensor-plus-tablet as a patient monitoring system (9018.19.55)
classification.rationale: Gabi measures pulse rate and SpO2 using PPG, a medical device for checking physiological parameters in heading 9018. H338599 placed pulse oximeters in 9018.19.95 and N353388 placed a BLE vital-sign device with app at 9018.19.9550. The kit is classified by the sensor under GRI 3(b). Suffix .50 other apparatus; 9018.19.55 remains a possible alternative.
